subject: design/argus-journal-type-recovery
statement: For a fully valid committed delivery ledger, retain the predecessor's exact historical paths, own problem subtree, three-digit numbered plan Markdown/JSON, and flat native Document JSON/body grammar. With malformed committed input, no numbered plan scope is added.
